items.name: lumesec-theme
items.title: LumeSec accent tokens
items.description: Adds the --lumesec accent tokens (Electric, its soft shade, shine, glint, success, warning, info) to your shadcn theme, with Tailwind colours.

items.name: lumesec-canvas
items.title: Canvas sizing
items.description: Device-pixel-ratio aware canvas sizing, pixel snapping and pointer positions in CSS pixels.

items.name: lumesec-color
items.title: Theme colours
items.description: Resolves theme CSS variables (any colour format) to RGB for canvas drawing and repaints on theme changes.

items.name: lumesec-data
items.title: Data inputs
items.description: Reads and validates the JSON `data` attribute and property that custom elements take for your records.

items.name: lumesec-fuzzy
items.title: Fuzzy match
items.description: Fuzzy matching and match highlighting for search and command lists.

items.name: lumesec-geo
items.title: Geo helpers
items.description: Map and globe projections, great-circle lines, rotation and dot lattices for the Location components.

items.name: lumesec-geo-countries
items.title: Country data
items.description: ISO codes, names, regions, label points and simplified outlines of 175 countries (Natural Earth).

items.name: lumesec-geo-data
items.title: Geo data and text
items.description: Time zones, coordinate, distance and IP parsing and formatting, demo cities and regions, and seeded randomness for the Location components.

items.name: lumesec-geo-world
items.title: World data
items.description: An embedded land mask at 0.5° and simplified coastlines (Natural Earth, public domain).

items.name: lumesec-math
items.title: Math helpers
items.description: Clamp, lerp, easing, hashing and RGB colour helpers.

items.name: lumesec-motion
items.title: Motion hooks
items.description: Reduced motion, in-view detection, an off-screen-aware animation loop, lazy refs, springs and shake.

items.name: lumesec-engine-pixel
items.title: Pixel engine
items.description: Runtime for the Pixel Lab and Pixel HD custom elements: theme tokens, base element, animation loop, drawing helpers.

items.name: lumesec-pixel-canvas
items.title: Pixel canvas
items.description: The canvas loop behind the Pixel UI components.

items.name: lumesec-pixel-font
items.title: Pixel font
items.description: The 5x7 pixel font and bitmap helpers.

items.name: lumesec-react
items.title: React bindings
items.description: Renders LumeSec custom elements from React 19, wires their custom events and composes refs.

items.name: lumesec-roll-text
items.title: Rolling text
items.description: Text that rolls over a horizontal axis when it changes.

items.name: lumesec-sparks
items.title: Sparks
items.description: Square pixel sparks, in a canvas or as a one-off burst over a component.

items.name: lumesec-use-controllable-state
items.title: Controllable state
items.description: State that can be controlled or uncontrolled, like a native input.

items.name: effort-slider
items.title: Ultracode slider
items.description: Six-level effort slider whose last stop, Ultracode, grows a pulsing pixel trail from the thumb and fires a burst when the thumb lands.

items.name: ui-thinking
items.title: Thinking indicator
items.description: Thinking indicator with a pixel wave and a rolling seconds counter; when finished it reads "Thought for Ns" and expands to show the reasoning.

items.name: ui-send-button
items.title: Send / stop button
items.description: Round send button that turns into a stop button with an orbiting ring while a reply streams, then closes the ring with sparks on completion.

items.name: ui-toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Switch with a label and hint whose thumb stretches as it travels and pops a few pixel sparks when it turns on.

items.name: ui-segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Segmented control whose selection pill is driven by two springs, so it stretches between options and recolours labels exactly where it covers them.

items.name: ui-copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copy-to-clipboard button whose icon turns into a drawn check as the label rolls to "Copied"; it says so when the browser refuses.

items.name: ui-hold-button
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Hold-to-confirm button for destructive actions: holding fills it as the bin lid lifts; letting go early drains it with a shake.

items.name: ui-odometer
items.title: Odometer stepper
items.description: Number stepper where every digit is its own rolling wheel; supports press-and-hold, sideways drag, the scroll wheel and the keyboard.

items.name: ui-toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Toast stack where new toasts spring up from below, hover or focus fans the stack out and pauses timers, and a sideways swipe dismisses.

items.name: ui-dial
items.title: Rotary dial
items.description: Rotary dial that follows the pointer around a 270° arc, flashing a tick and rolling the value at each detent, then springs onto the step.

items.name: ui-context-meter
items.title: Context meter
items.description: Context-window meter that fills a pixel strip behind a glowing front, turns amber at 80% and red at 95%, and animates compaction.

items.name: px-agents
items.title: Agent workflow
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Animated multi-agent workflow on a pixel canvas: a planner fans work out to four agents and a verifier merges the results.

items.name: px-gauge
items.title: Throughput gauge
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Half-circle pixel gauge for tokens per second with amber and red zones, a spring needle that overshoots and a peak marker.

items.name: px-hourglass
items.title: Rate-limit hourglass
items.description: Falling-sand hourglass that counts down to a usage reset; the remaining time is derived from the sand left in the top chamber.

items.name: px-splitflap
items.title: Split-flap board
items.description: Split-flap departure board whose tiles flip through the alphabet and cascade left to right on each new message.

items.name: px-xypad
items.title: Sampling pad
items.description: Two-axis pad for temperature and top-p on a glowing pixel field; on release the puck springs onto the nearest 0.05 step.

items.name: px-voice
items.title: Voice input
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Simulated dictation control with a mirrored pixel spectrum and words that fade into focus; stopping collapses the bars to a point.

items.name: px-materialize
items.title: Materializing stream
items.description: Streams a sentence word by word, each word condensing from particles sampled from its own glyphs before resolving into crisp text.

items.name: px-model
items.title: Model morph
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Model picker where one pixel swarm morphs between a diamond, a ring and a rotating star, with speed, depth and cost bars.

items.name: px-secret
items.title: Secret field
items.description: API key field hidden under crawling pixel noise; holding the eye wipes the noise away and each character decodes before it locks.

items.name: px-orb
items.title: Status orb
items.description: Pixel disc showing an agent's state (idle, listening, thinking, working, error, done), dissolving cell by cell between states.

items.name: px-fader
items.title: Fader & meter
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Mixing-desk fader beside a stereo pixel meter with falling peak-hold segments and a clip light above 0 dB.

items.name: px-range
items.title: Histogram range
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Two-thumb response-time filter over a pixel histogram; columns fill as they enter the range and the run count rolls as you drag.

items.name: px-focus
items.title: Focus timer
items.description: Focus timer drawn as a ring of 60 pixels; one breaks loose each interval and drops into a sand pile, and reset flies them back.

items.name: px-deploy
items.title: Slide to deploy
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Slide-to-deploy control whose pixel trail heats up as you drag; releasing past 90% bursts, runs a deploy scan and shows Live.

items.name: px-activity
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Activity heatmap where each day is nine sub-pixels, so intensity shows as brightness and density; switching metric flips cells in a wave.

items.name: px-storage
items.title: Storage ring
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Pixel donut chart of storage use that sweeps in clockwise; pointing at a segment pushes its pixels outward and click pins it.

items.name: px-identicon
items.title: Pixel avatar
items.description: Symmetric 7x7 pixel avatar generated from a typed name; changed cells flip in a ring spreading from the centre as the hue drifts.

items.name: px-signal
items.title: Latency scope
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Scrolling pixel oscilloscope for latency with dithered tails, amber and red spikes over a 400 ms line, and a rolling p50/p95 readout.

items.name: px-react
items.title: Pixel reactions
items.description: Pixel like button whose heart explodes and snaps back filled; press and hold opens four more reactions that the same pixels fly into.

items.name: px-upload
items.title: Pixel upload
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Upload drop zone where the file icon dissolves pixel by pixel into the progress bar, which regroups into a check; oversized files shake red.

items.name: px-charge
items.title: Charge to generate
items.description: Press-and-hold generate button: pixels spiral in as a ring fills, and release fires a shockwave sized to the charge, one to four variations.

items.name: px-pattern
items.title: Pattern lock
items.description: 3x3 pattern lock with a pixel trail; skipped middle nodes join automatically, a wrong pattern shatters and falls, a right one turns green.

items.name: px-tasks
items.title: Pixel checklist
items.description: Pixel checklist where checking fills the box from the centre and draws a fizzing strike-through; finishing the list runs a green wave.

items.name: px-xp
items.title: Level up
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). XP bar with a hot leading edge; when it overflows the bar flashes and the level number bursts into pixels that reassemble as the next level.

items.name: px-dissolve
items.title: Dissolve to delete
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Chat list where deleting a row turns it into pixels sampled from its own text, which drift away left to right before the gap closes.

items.name: px-launch
items.title: Release rocket
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Release animation with a pixel rocket: a three-second countdown, smoke on the pad, then liftoff while the stars streak past.

items.name: px-theme
items.title: Day / night switch
items.description: Day/night switch whose sun pixels rebuild as a crescent moon while night sweeps the sky; it can set the page theme.

items.name: px-rating
items.title: Pixel stars
items.description: Five pixel stars that fill like liquid as you hover; picking one pops it with sparks and rolls the label.

items.name: px-bell
items.title: Notification bell
items.description: Pixel notification bell that swings with a lagging clapper and pops its badge on new items; clicking it clears the badge in a spray of pixels.

items.name: px-flame
items.title: Temperature fire
items.description: Temperature slider drawn as a pixel fire simulation: low values leave embers, high values burn tall and Wild throws sparks.

items.name: px-tuner
items.title: Radio tuner
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). FM radio tuner where static thins out near a station, a waveform appears and the name resolves on lock; release nearby springs onto it.

items.name: px-eq
items.title: Equalizer
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Seven-band pixel equalizer with spring-loaded bands, a smooth curve and a live spectrum behind; presets cascade band by band.

items.name: px-jog
items.title: Jog wheel
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Pixel jog wheel that keeps spinning with inertia after release, driving a running timecode and a filmstrip that scrubs underneath.

items.name: px-metronome
items.title: Metronome
items.description: Pixel metronome with a swinging pendulum whose weight slides with tempo, four beat lamps, tap tempo and optional click sound.

items.name: px-color
items.title: Pixel colour picker
items.description: Colour picker made of pixel cells with a fisheye under the pointer; a new hue ripples across the grid from where you clicked.

items.name: px-sketch
items.title: Mirror sketchpad
items.description: 16x16 pixel drawing pad with mirror mode for symmetric strokes; cells pop as you paint and Clear drops every pixel with gravity.

items.name: px-waffle
items.title: Context waffle
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Context window as a 200-cell waffle, one cell per thousand tokens; attached files fly in and compacting crumbles the conversation.

items.name: px-ticker
items.title: LED ticker
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). LED marquee with glowing text over a grid of unlit dots, coloured up and down arrows and soft edges; hovering eases it to a stop.

items.name: px-radar
items.title: Service radar
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Sweeping pixel radar where each service node lights up as the beam passes; Ping sends out a ring that flashes every node it touches.

items.name: px-uptime
items.title: Uptime history
items.description: Ninety days of uptime per service as pixel columns swept in on load; hovering a day lifts that column across all services.

items.name: px-clock
items.title: Morphing clock
items.description: Live clock where each changing digit rolls to the next and sheds a few pixels; switching time zone rolls every digit at once.

items.name: px-player
items.title: Waveform player
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Pixel waveform player that fills as it plays, previews ahead of the playhead on hover and ripples from wherever you click.

items.name: px-globe
items.title: Request globe
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Dotted pixel globe with nine regions; requests arc between them as glowing packets, each arrival flashes its node. Drag to spin it.

items.name: px-minimap
items.title: Code minimap
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Syntax-coloured pixel minimap beside a code view with the visible window outlined; search hits pulse in the margin and dragging scrolls.

items.name: px-diffusion
items.title: Diffusion preview
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Image preview that resolves the way diffusion models do: noise and large blocks sharpen over 30 steps into a scene, different each variation.

items.name: px-stepper
items.title: Snake stepper
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Five-step onboarding progress drawn as a pixel snake that circles the current step, slithers to the next, eats it and grows.

items.name: px-spinners
items.title: Pixel loaders
items.description: Six pixel loading indicators (orbit, snake, helix, scan, rain, pulse); clicking one finishes it with a check before it restarts.

items.name: px-keys
items.title: Typing heatmap
items.description: Typing test over a pixel keyboard where each key flashes, ripples to its neighbours, builds heat with use and turns red on a miss.

items.name: px-tokenize
items.title: Token view
items.description: Live token view: typed text splits into tinted spans and a strip of pixels where new tokens drop in, using a rough tokenizer.

items.name: px-battery
items.title: Usage battery
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Weekly usage shown as a pixel battery; spending knocks cells loose and resetting runs current along the cable until it is full.

items.name: px-input
items.title: Text field
items.description: Labelled form text field whose underline lights from the caret outwards; validation on blur shakes on error or draws a check.

items.name: px-password
items.title: Password
items.description: Password field with a four-segment pixel strength meter, a show/hide toggle and a rule checklist; minScore blocks weak passwords.

items.name: px-otp
items.title: One-time code
items.description: Six-digit one-time-code field backed by one real input, so typing, paste and code autofill work; a wrong code shakes and falls away.

items.name: px-search
items.title: Search with results
items.description: Search field with fuzzy matching, highlighted letters and a pixel highlight that springs between results; `hotkey` makes "/" focus it.

items.name: px-select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select with a menu that unfolds downward, a pixel highlight that springs between options and type-ahead by first letter.

items.name: px-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Form slider with a pixel track, a springy thumb, optional tick marks and a rolling value label with a prefix or unit.

items.name: px-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Form checkbox that fills from the centre and draws its check, with a mixed state for parent and child selections.

items.name: px-choice
items.title: Option cards
items.description: Radio group rendered as option cards; the selection outline is made of pixels that fly to the newly selected card, then keep circling.

items.name: px-tags
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Tag input where Enter or comma adds a chip and Backspace twice removes the last; duplicates shake and removed tags break into pixels.

items.name: px-date
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Month-grid date picker for single dates or ranges, with a springing pixel selection block, a dotted range band and a mark on today.

items.name: px-textarea
items.title: Text area with budget
items.description: Auto-growing text area with a pixel character budget that turns amber near the limit and blinks red when over, marking the form invalid.

items.name: px-button
items.title: Async button
items.description: Async button: a promise from onClick shows a pixel spinner, then a drawn check or a shake with "Try again", and returns to its label after 1.8 s.

items.name: px-confirm
items.title: Two-step delete
items.description: Two-step delete button: the first click arms it and a pixel fuse burns down; a second click inside the window confirms with a burst.

items.name: px-toaster
items.title: Toasts
items.description: Toast stack with pixel type icons and a draining timer bar that pauses on hover or focus; it can be pinned to a viewport corner.

items.name: px-progress
items.title: Progress bar
items.description: Pixel progress bar: determinate with a hot leading edge and a green sweep at 100%, or an indeterminate comet when there is no value.

items.name: px-ring
items.title: Progress ring
items.description: Circular pixel progress ring with the percentage counting up in its centre; it turns green and throws a few sparks when it reaches 100%.

items.name: px-skeleton
items.title: Loading skeleton
items.description: Loading wrapper that shows shimmering pixel bars over its content and dissolves them as the content fades in when loading ends.

items.name: px-empty
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Empty state with one of four pixel illustrations that drop into place and float, plus a title, a line of help and room for actions.

items.name: px-alert
items.title: Inline alert
items.description: Inline alert in four tones with a pixel icon and a glowing stripe; dismissing scatters the stripe and collapses the alert.

items.name: px-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip whose bubble grows out of its arrow pixel by pixel on hover or keyboard focus before the text fades in; Escape hides it.

items.name: px-avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar with initials on a pixel field coloured from the name, a status dot that pulses when online and a hover ripple.

items.name: px-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose underline is forty pixels that stream from the old tab to the new one, with panels that slide in from the side.

items.name: px-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination with previous and next buttons, page numbers and ellipses, where a pixel block slides to the page you pick.

items.name: px-nav
items.title: Sidebar nav
items.description: Sidebar nav with pixel icons and count badges, a hover block and an active bar that slides to the current item.

items.name: px-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion whose pixel plus signs fold into minus signs while the panels open smoothly; one or several items can stay open.

items.name: px-command
items.title: Command menu
items.description: ⌘K / Ctrl+K command palette with grouped commands, fuzzy search and a springing pixel highlight; focus stays in it while open.

items.name: px-steps
items.title: Wizard steps
items.description: Wizard progress with numbered nodes joined by pixel lines that fill as you advance; finished steps show a check and lead back on click.

items.name: px-sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Inline pixel sparkline with a dithered area, coloured green or red by trend unless a colour is set; hovering shows the value.

items.name: px-bars
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Pixel bar chart whose bars grow cell by cell and spring to new data; hover or the arrow keys show exact values in a tooltip.

items.name: px-kpi
items.title: Stat tile
items.description: Stat tile with a rolling value, a change chip against a previous value and a pixel history; invert makes a drop read as good.

items.name: hf-button
items.title: Button
items.description: Dot-matrix button with a pointer light and press ripples; `run(fn)` shows loading, success and error states around a promise.

items.name: hf-switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Form-associated switch whose track fills with a dithered energy field when on; the thumb springs across with a few sparks.

items.name: hf-segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Segmented radio group whose selected slab stretches toward the new option on a spring. Form-associated; arrow keys move it.

items.name: hf-input
items.title: Text field
items.description: Form-associated text field with a comet of light on the border while focused; invalid values turn the border to static.

items.name: hf-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: Chat input with an aurora border and an effort chip; Enter sends and fires a `send` event with the text and effort level.

items.name: hf-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Form-associated range slider with a dithered fill and a lens for a thumb that magnifies the dots beneath it.

items.name: hf-knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: Form-associated rotary knob drawn as a dithered sphere with an arc of lit cells; set it by drag, scroll wheel or arrow keys.

items.name: hf-dropzone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). File drop zone drawn as a ripple simulation; dropped or picked files are listed with a simulated dotted progress bar.

items.name: hf-pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Pricing card with a monthly and yearly toggle; the price rolls to the new number while a bright edge wipes through the dot grid behind it.

items.name: hf-kbd
items.title: Shortcut keys
items.description: Keycaps drawn in dots with their key names set in type; they press down while the real keys are held and fire `trigger` when the combination is down.

items.name: hf-progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar drawn as a fluid with rising bubbles; at 100% the label rolls to its done text. Omit `value` for indeterminate.

items.name: hf-context
items.title: Context window
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Context-window meter with four dithered segments, warnings at 80% and 95% and a compaction sweep; runs on built-in demo data.

items.name: hf-gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: Semicircular gauge of green, amber and red cells with a sprung pointer; the zone word rolls when the value crosses a threshold.

items.name: hf-rings
items.title: Goal rings
items.description: Up to three concentric goal rings with glowing heads; progress past the goal laps the ring in a brighter tint and throws sparks.

items.name: hf-status
items.title: Uptime
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Uptime chart of daily bars coloured by incidents, with today pulsing; hover or use the arrow keys to read a day's figures.

items.name: hf-terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Simulated shell with phosphor-flash output, dotted progress bars and a glowing block caret; runs a set of built-in demo commands.

items.name: hf-countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: HH:MM:SS countdown set over a dot grid; changed digits roll over as their tile reprints, the last ten seconds turn red and zero bursts.

items.name: hf-banner
items.title: Announcement
items.description: Announcement banner on a dithered gradient with a passing sheen; dismissing breaks it into dots that blow away before it collapses.

items.name: hf-effort
items.title: Effort slider
items.description: Six-level effort slider; reaching Ultracode bursts and grows a trail of light behind the thumb. Form-associated.

items.name: hf-modes
items.title: Mode picker
items.description: Three mode cards (Chat, Code, Ultracode) on one canvas; the selected card gets an aurora and a comet on its border. Form-associated.

items.name: hf-run
items.title: Agent run
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Simulated agent run: steps show a spinning arc while running and a carved check when done, with elapsed time and tokens on top.

items.name: hf-stream
items.title: Streaming reply
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Streaming reply where each word resolves out of noise behind a glowing block caret, with a dotted tokens-per-second sparkline.

items.name: hf-area
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Area chart with a bright line over a dithered fill; ranges morph into each other and hover adds a crosshair and the value.

items.name: hf-donut
items.title: Donut
items.description: Donut chart that sweeps in clockwise; hovering or arrowing to a segment pops it outward and rolls its share into the centre.

items.name: hf-stat
items.title: Stat tile
items.description: Stat tile whose number counts up over a shimmer of dots; hovering the sparkline shows the value under the pointer.

items.name: hf-funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: Funnel chart where dots fall through the stages in proportion to conversion and drop-outs turn red and drift off the side.

items.name: hf-barlist
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Ranked bar list with dithered bars behind the labels that grow in one after another; hover or focus runs a sheen along a bar.

items.name: hf-card
items.title: Media card
items.description: Media card with a generated dithered landscape whose ridges shift at different depths as the card tilts toward the pointer.

items.name: hf-hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Hero section whose headline sits in a dot grid and is revealed behind a bright front; the pointer pushes dots aside and a click sends a shockwave.

items.name: hf-reveal
items.title: Secret field
items.description: Secret field that hides its value under live static; revealing dissolves the noise outward from the click and re-hides after 15 s.

items.name: hf-wheel
items.title: Time picker wheel
items.description: Two-column time picker wheel: rows curve on a cylinder, flings carry inertia and snap to a value that submits as HH:MM.

items.name: hf-range
items.title: Range filter
items.description: Dual-thumb range filter over a dithered histogram; bars inside the range light up and a result count follows as you drag or type.

items.name: hf-chips
items.title: Filter chips
items.description: Multi-select filter chips: selecting floods a chip with dots from the click point and draws a check. Submits one value per chip.

items.name: hf-number
items.title: Number stepper
items.description: Integer stepper whose number rolls over a dotted wash; holding a button repeats faster, and stepping past a limit shakes and flashes red.

items.name: hf-swipe
items.title: Slide to confirm
items.description: Slide-to-confirm track for deliberate actions: the handle must reach the end, keyboard users hold Enter, and it re-arms after a delay.

items.name: hf-pin
items.title: PIN pad
items.description: Numeric PIN pad with rippling keys and dot feedback: a wrong code shakes into red static, the right one sends a green wave.

items.name: hf-split
items.title: Split button
items.description: Split button with a primary action and a menu of alternatives; choosing an item rolls its label into the main button.

items.name: hf-mention
items.title: @mention field
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Textarea with @mention suggestions for files, people and agents; matched letters are marked and inserted mentions become dotted chips.

items.name: hf-approve
items.title: Permission prompt
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Agent permission prompt: a scan runs over the command, a risk meter fills, and Allow once, Always allow or Deny settles it.

items.name: hf-diff
items.title: Diff review
items.description: Unified diff reviewer with dithered add and remove tints and a minimap; accepting or rejecting a hunk dissolves the dropped lines.

items.name: hf-tree
items.title: Changed files
items.description: Changed-files tree built from a path list with M, A and D markers; folders count their changes and arrow keys follow the tree pattern.

items.name: hf-graph
items.title: Agent graph
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Agent workflow graph that plays a run from lead agent to planner, three parallel agents and a reviewer, with light along live edges.

items.name: hf-redact
items.title: PII redaction
items.description: Shows text next to what a model would see, with names, emails, IBANs and phone numbers swapped for placeholders like EMAIL_1.

items.name: hf-rewind
items.title: Checkpoints
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Checkpoint scrubber for a coding session: each jump runs a rewind glitch over the code, and changed lines get a green bar.

items.name: hf-sources
items.title: Sources and citations
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Paragraph with numbered citations; hovering or focusing one draws a dotted beam to its source chip and loads a preview card.

items.name: hf-matrix
items.title: Usage heatmap
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Weekday-by-hour usage heatmap in which dot density is the value; the peak pulses, and hover or arrow keys show a cell's count.

items.name: hf-scatter
items.title: Scatter with brush
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Scatter plot of 270 runs with a drag-to-select brush; the summary rolls to the selection's medians and the legend toggles groups.

items.name: hf-candles
items.title: Candlesticks
items.description: Candlestick chart with dithered bodies, wicks, volume and a last-price line; takes your OHLC candles and streams new ones with `push()`, or shows a live demo walk.

items.name: hf-flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Sankey from Chat, Code and API to three models, with particles streaming in proportion to traffic; hovering a band isolates it.

items.name: hf-gantt
items.title: Roadmap
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Roadmap Gantt chart with dithered progress bars, a pulsing milestone and a today line; bars drag or resize, snapping by day.

items.name: hf-leaderboard
items.title: Live leaderboard
items.description: Leaderboard: rows rank by score, overtaking rows slide past each other with trails, ranks roll, changes flash and the leader gets a ring; takes your rows or shows live demo teams.

items.name: hf-radial
items.title: Radial bars
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Radial bar chart of twelve months, denser toward each tip; hovering or the arrow keys roll a month's value into the centre.

items.name: hf-marquee
items.title: Logo marquee
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Two rows of placeholder wordmarks drifting in opposite directions between dotted rules; the row under the pointer slows down.

items.name: hf-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal invite dialog on the native dialog element: focus is trapped, Escape closes it, and pixels fly from the trigger to build the panel.

items.name: hf-kanban
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Three-column kanban board: a dragged card leaves a dot trail, the target column lights up and a bar marks where it will land.

items.name: hf-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Carousel of four procedural pixel scenes with an ordered-dither dissolve between slides; autoplay pauses on hover or focus.

items.name: hf-spotlight
items.title: Product tour
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Product tour over a mock app: dithered dimming, a rounded cut-out with a comet on its edge, and a step card that moves between targets.

items.name: hf-consent
items.title: Privacy choices
items.description: Privacy choices card whose shield fills as categories are allowed; saving stamps it and folds the card into a small Change pill.

items.name: hf-error
items.title: Error state
items.description: Error state with the code in large mono type over a dotted scanline halo that glitches now and then; Try again reassembles it.

items.name: hf-compare
items.title: Before and after
items.description: Demo data (a template: it cannot show your own data yet). Before-and-after slider over a mock document: personal data is highlighted on the left and blacked out on the right.

items.name: geo-globe
items.title: Connection globe
items.description: A dotted globe with connections as dotted arcs. Each landing lights the land around the destination in an uneven ring and throws sparks past the edge.

items.name: geo-horizon
items.title: Horizon globe
items.description: The top of a large dotted globe rising from the bottom edge, for page heroes, with arcs that climb into the sky between places.

items.name: geo-daynight
items.title: Day and night
items.description: A dotted globe split by the terminator, with a dithered twilight band and city lights that switch on as night reaches them.

items.name: geo-spikes
items.title: Event spikes
items.description: Counts per location as dot spikes on a globe; new data grows them in a wave from the biggest increase, led by a ring of light.

items.name: geo-unfold
items.title: Globe to map
items.description: One set of land dots that is either a globe or a flat map: switching peels the globe open at the back and lays it flat, routes and packets included.

items.name: geo-badge
items.title: Region badge
items.description: A pill with a tiny dotted globe, a region name and its latency. On a region change the globe turns to it and a ring pings across its dots.

items.name: geo-marker-map
items.title: Marker map
items.description: A flat map of land dots with markers. Values light halos of dots sized by area, which spring to new values; labels place themselves.

items.name: geo-visitors
items.title: Live visitors
items.description: A live map of visits with a feed and an online-now count: each visit drops onto the map with a ring of light, and leaves an afterglow.

items.name: geo-flows
items.title: Region traffic
items.description: Traffic between regions as dotted curves whose rows and particle rate follow throughput; selecting a region isolates its flows and rolls its totals.

items.name: geo-choropleth
items.title: Country values
items.description: Values per country as dot density: land dots switch on in an ordered-dither pattern, and a change rebuilds each country's print dot by dot.

items.name: geo-cluster
items.title: Clustered map
items.description: A zoomable dot map for many points: nearby points merge into counted clusters that split apart as you zoom in and pull back together as you zoom out.

items.name: geo-mini-map
items.title: Location cell
items.description: A world thumbnail with one point for table cells. Hover or focus it and a popover grows out of the point while the map inside zooms in on it.

items.name: geo-catchment
items.title: Anycast catchment
items.description: Which point of presence serves which part of the world, as a dot map. Turn a site off and its neighbours flood the hole from their own side.

items.name: geo-mesh
items.title: Mesh connections
items.description: The devices of a private network and how this device reaches each one, directly or through a relay server; an upgrade lets go of the relay with a wobble.

items.name: geo-traceroute
items.title: Traceroute
items.description: A traceroute as a hop table and a dotted map; the packet waits at each hop for its share of the round-trip time, so slow hops are slow to watch.

items.name: geo-latency-matrix
items.title: Latency matrix
items.description: Round-trip times between regions as dot blocks that fill with latency; a map beside the grid slides the measured route from pair to pair.

items.name: geo-probes
items.title: Global checks
items.description: Uptime checks from many locations against one target: the arcs race to the target, so the order they land in is the latency ranking.

items.name: geo-azimuthal
items.title: Distance from here
items.description: A round map with one place at the centre and every other place at its true distance and direction. Re-centring grows the map outward.

items.name: geo-access
items.title: Sign-in travel
items.description: An account's sign-ins joined by legs on a map, with the time and distance between them. A move faster than travel allows tears apart.

items.name: geo-threats
items.title: Attack origins
items.description: Inbound requests converge on a protected site at the centre of a dotted globe. Blocked ones dent its shield ring and burst off it.

items.name: geo-geofence
items.title: Geofence
items.description: Geofence zones as true geodesic circles on a dot map. A device that leaves every zone plucks the fence it crossed, and a wave runs around it.

items.name: geo-sessions
items.title: Active sessions
items.description: The places an account is signed in, as a list with a dot map. Signing out other sessions sends a wave from this device that removes them nearest first.

items.name: geo-residency
items.title: Data residency
items.description: Where data is stored and processed, measured against a jurisdiction. Transfers that cross the zone's border flare there and turn into warning lines.

items.name: geo-ip
items.title: IP lookup
items.description: A field that looks up where an IP address is located and shows the result on a small map.

items.name: geo-region-picker
items.title: Region picker
items.description: Pick a deployment region from a list with a dot map. The reticle travels along the great circle, magnifying the land dots it passes.

items.name: geo-location-picker
items.title: Location picker
items.description: Choose a point on a dot map by click, search or typed coordinates. The pin drops on a spring and lands with a splash that ripples the dots.

items.name: geo-area
items.title: Area select
items.description: Select an area by drawing a latitude and longitude box on a dot map. The land inside fills behind the pointer and the edges snap to whole degrees.

items.name: geo-coordinate
items.title: Coordinate field
items.description: A text field for coordinates in decimal or DMS notation, with a small world map whose parallel and meridian follow what it reads.

items.name: geo-timezones
items.title: Meeting planner
items.description: A meeting planner: one row of hour blocks per city, dense for working hours, with the hours every city shares lit as an accent band.

items.name: geo-route
items.title: Route playback
items.description: Replays a recorded track on a dotted map: the marker turns along its heading and leaves a wake of dots that cools behind it; stops leave a ring.

items.name: interaction
items.title: Interaction collection
items.description: Every Interaction component (11). Micro-interactions on everyday controls: send buttons, toggles, dials, meters.

items.name: pixel-lab
items.title: Pixel Lab collection
items.description: Every Pixel Lab component (50). Components that live in a pixel lattice: meters, gauges, orbs, radars, AI moments.

items.name: pixel-ui
items.title: Pixel UI collection
items.description: Every Pixel UI component (30). Form controls you can ship, each with one pixel detail.

items.name: pixel-hd
items.title: Pixel HD collection
items.description: Every Pixel HD component (60). Regular controls on a high-fidelity dot field with bloom and ordered dither.

items.name: location
items.title: Location collection
items.description: Every Location component (30). Globes, maps and connection lines for locations, visitors, sign-ins, latency and traffic between regions.
